rows.title: With 'Thoroughbreds,' First-Time filmmaker Cory Finley Explores the Concept of Privilege Through Satire
rows.comment: A superbly calibrated comedy that steadily paces into thriller territory
rows.verdict_le10: A superbly calibrated comedy that steadily paces into thriller territory
rows.dek_lead: A superbly calibrated comedy that steadily paces into thriller territory, writer-director Cory Finley’s pristine debut feature Thoroughbreds boasts confidence and stylistic precision.
